steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Every component has a standard symbol: resistor (zigzag or rectangle), capacitor (parallel lines), diode (triangle with bar), transistor (arrow on emitter). | Key Fact: Wires without a junction dot do not connect; wires that cross with a dot at the intersection are connected. | Key Fact: Draw circuit diagrams with the signal flowing from left to right and power rails at the top (positive) and bottom (0 V / ground). | Key Fact: Label all components with their values (e.g. R1 = 10 kΩ, C1 = 100 μF) and reference designators.
